content: 1. Continue using this medication as prescribed. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. 2. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to obtain a new dosing schedule. 3. Before mixing, store the dry powder and the mixing solution at room temperature. After mixing, refrigerate the medication and use it within 24 hours. 4. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 5. This information was last updated in August 2024. 6. This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. 7. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your individual health needs. 8. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 9. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., liver function tests) should be conducted as directed by your healthcare provider. Ensure that you keep all medical and laboratory appointments.
